facility.name: Dimples Childcare Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 6720 HOMESTEAD RD, HOUSTON, TX, 77028

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License: 1 out of 4 staff files missing a copy of a photo identification. Note: this was corrected at inspection when a copy of the ID was made.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 1 out of 4 staff files is missing documentation showing how the employee meets the minimum age and education qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: 1 staff member who has been an employee since 2022 is missing the Health and Safety Audit annual trainings for Administering Medications, Hazardous Materials and Food Allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored Out of Children's Reach: A children's inflatable wading pool is stored on the playground making it accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored Out of Children's Reach (26 TAC §746.5013(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: 2 out of 4 staff files is missing documentation showing the dates of the first day on the job.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Present on the playground is a wooden border that has come apart and poses a tripping hazard. The grass on the playground needs to be cut.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: 2 children in high chairs were unfastened. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver fastened the safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - Infant Birth to 12 Months: The infant written activity plan and daily schedule does not reflect outdoor time opportunities for infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - Infant Birth to 12 Months (26 TAC §746.2206(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Two children were eating breakfast with screen time. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver turned off the tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height: Two children under 4'9" were riding in the general purpose vehicle without a booster seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: 2 out of 2 transportation vehicles,  purchased or leased on or after December 31, 2013, is not working or maintained according to the manufacturer's instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: 1 out of 4 children transported is missing the emergency medical authorization form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: 2 out of 2 transportation vehicles had non-working fire extinguishers with the needle in the red.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: A first aid kit for 1 transportation vehicle was incomplete, missing the thermometer and scissors . Note: this was corrected at inspection when the driver added the items to the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 out of 4 children files missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The center is missing documentation of emergency drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Operational policies missing information for a parent or guardian of a child at a child care facility has the right to: (1) enter and examine the child care facility during the facility's hours of operation without advanced notice; (3) receive inspection reports for the child care facility and information about how to access the facility's online compliance history; (4) obtain a copy of the child care facility's policies and procedures; (5) review, at the request of the parent or guardian, the facility's: (A) staff training records; and (B) any in-house staff training curriculum used by the facility; (6) review the child care facility's written records concerning the parent's or guardian's child; (7) inspect any video recordings of an alleged incident of abuse or neglect involving the parent's or guardian's child, provided that: (A) video recordings of the alleged incident are available; (B) the parent or guardian of the child does not retain any part of the video recording depicting a child that is not their own; and (C) the parent or guardian of any other child captured in the video recording receives written notice from the facility before allowing a parent to inspect a recording; (8) have the child care facility comply with a court order preventing another parent or guardian from visiting or removing the parent's or guardian's child; (9) be provided the contact information for the child care facility's local Child Care Regulation office; (10) file a complaint against the child care facility by contacting the local Child Care Regulation office; and (11) be free from any retaliatory action by the child care facility for exercising any of the parent's or guardian's rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: 2 out of 4 staff missing one hour in abuse/neglect; 4 out of 4 staff missing SIDS/ Shaken baby/ early child brain development; 3 out of 4 missing emergency preparedness; 4 out of 4 missing communicable disease; 3 out of 4 missing administering medication; 3 out of 4 missing food allergy; 4 out of 4 missing building safety; 3 out of 4 missing hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: 1 infant is missing a written feeding instructions form. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the parent filled out a form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies is missing: (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;  	(B) The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;  	(C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation;  	(D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place;  	(E) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities; and  	(F) The criteria you will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play; and  	(G) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Missing the following records at the child-care center for one staff file:  Documentation showing the dates of the first day on the job;  Documentation showing how the employee meets the minimum age and education qualifications; A notarized Affidavit for Applicants for Employment;  A Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations (Form 2912); A statement signed and dated by the employee showing he has received a copy of the child-care center's: (A)Operational policies;  A statement signed and dated by the employee verifying the date the employee attended training during orientation that includes an overview of your policy on the prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: 1 out of 4 staff files missing transportation training for caregivers that transport.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The tracking system for each child coming and going from your child-care center throughout the day was not maintained for all children attending care. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the director updated the daily log sheet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A tv was playing cartoons in the infant room with children under 2 years old. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver turned off the tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The center's director owes 2-hour training for transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lighting in the infant room was low enough that the caregiver was not seen sitting on the floor during nap time.    Note: this was corrected at inspection when the director turned on the hallway light that adequately illuminated the infant room through the hallway windows.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Three infants were napping in the same room as seven  preK children ages 3-4 years old. The youngest being 12months old and the oldest being 4 years old, more than 18 month gap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The center last completed a gas leak inspection on 11/10/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The operation needs a carbon monoxide detector installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The policy for promotion of physical activities needs to be developed in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The center's director owes 2-hour training for transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 2 out of 2 caregiver files is missing required topics: Emergency Preparedness, Administering Medications, Hazardous Materials, Food Allergies, Building and Premises Safety, Communicable Diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: A 15"x9" hole in the wall is present and within reach, located in the computer room used by the school-age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director has 30 hours of annual training completed, however missing required topics:  Administering Medications, Hazardous Materials, Food Allergies, Building and Premises Safety, Communicable Diseases, SIDS/Abusive head trauma/Shaken Baby/Early Child Development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: The operation did not have the children's parents information or  emergency telephone numbers in the blinder they carry during transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The operation did not have any loose-fill surfacing material under the moving equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the playground the back gate has a hole in the fence this leads to the street on the side of the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
